name: Tilted UI dolly
description: The product screen on a 3D perspective plane; the camera slides and zooms to each control.

recipe.build: Container perspective:1400px, plane rotateY(-18deg) rotateX(8deg), GSAP scale and translate with power2.inOut; blur anything off-focus with filter.

avoid: Do not tilt more than 25 degrees; no UI text under 14 px; never a fake or invented screen.
